notes: Stage naming: "<Region>: <n>", n=1..7 within region; stage 4 hosts the mini-boss (where present), stage 7 the boss (needs a skull of the difficulty to enter).
Levels are for Normal; on Nightmare and Inferno every enemy is level 70.
Attack damage = % of the enemy Damage stat (90-110% random); scaled_by_level gives Normal/Nightmare/Inferno absolute health/damage.
damage_types per stage = count of distinct attacks per element across the enemy types appearing on the stage (incl. boss and escorts).
